requirements.text: Ensure features align with PSD2 Strong Customer Authentication standards
Ensure compliance with GDPR for customer data storage and processing
Ensure compliance with Central Bank consumer protection rules for credit or lending features
Include real-time notifications for transaction details and balance updates
Implement card management functionality that allows customers to freeze and unfreeze their cards
Provide insights into spending habits, including categorization of monthly expenses by merchant type
Provide alerts when customers are approaching budget limits
Ensure all new features integrate with the existing core banking system without requiring major changes
Maintain compatibility with the current app version during the transition period
